description: Asthma is a chronic condition that affects the airways in the lungs, making them inflamed and narrow, which causes difficulty in breathing.
causes: Triggered by allergens (pollen, dust mites), respiratory infections, air pollution, cold air, or physical activity.
prevention: Avoid triggers, get vaccinated for flu/pneumonia, and monitor breathing.
treatment_action: Use prescribed inhalers (rescue or long-term), follow an asthma action plan.
complications: Permanent airway narrowing, severe attacks, medication side effects.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A progressive neurologic disorder that causes the brain to shrink and brain cells to die, leading to memory loss and cognitive decline.
causes: Brain protein failure, genetics, lifestyle, and environmental factors.
prevention: Healthy lifestyle (exercise, diet, mental stimulation) may reduce risk.
treatment_action: Medications to slow progression, caregiver support, and a safe environment.
complications: Inability to communicate, falls, difficulty swallowing, pneumonia.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: Inflammation or swelling of one or more joints, causing pain and stiffness.
causes: Osteoarthritis (wear and tear) or Rheumatoid arthritis (autoimmune).
prevention: Maintain healthy weight, exercise regularly, avoid injuries.
treatment_action: Physical therapy, medications (painkillers, anti-inflammatories), surgery.
complications: Joint deformity, difficulty performing daily tasks.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A condition in which you lack enough healthy red blood cells to carry adequate oxygen to your body's tissues.
causes: Iron deficiency, vitamin deficiency, chronic disease, or genetics.
prevention: Eat iron-rich foods (meat, beans, leafy greens) and vitamin-rich foods.
treatment_action: Iron supplements, vitamin supplements, or treating the underlying cause.
complications: Severe fatigue, heart problems, pregnancy complications, death (in severe cases).
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An inflammation of the appendix, a finger-shaped pouch that projects from your colon on the lower right side of your abdomen.
causes: Usually caused by a blockage in the lining of the appendix that results in infection.
symptoms: Sudden pain on the right side of the lower abdomen
prevention: No known way to prevent, but a high-fiber diet may reduce the risk.
treatment_action: Surgery to remove the appendix (appendectomy) and antibiotics.
complications: Ruptured appendix, pocket of pus that forms in the abdomen (abscess).
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A skin condition that occurs when your hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells.
causes: Excess oil production, clogged follicles, bacteria, and inflammation.
prevention: Wash skin gently, avoid touching face, use non-comedogenic products.
treatment_action: Over-the-counter creams, prescription medications, or light therapy.
complications: Scars, skin changes (dark or light spots), emotional distress.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) is a chronic, potentially life-threatening condition caused by the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).
causes: HIV infection, spread through contact with infected blood, semen, or vaginal fluids.
symptoms: Sore throat and painful mouth sores
prevention: Use protection during sex, don't share needles, and consider PrEP if at high risk.
treatment_action: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) to manage the virus and prevent progression.
complications: Opportunistic infections (pneumonia, TB), cancers, and wasting syndrome.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: Occur when your immune system reacts to a foreign substance — such as pollen, bee venom or pet dander — or a food that doesn't cause a reaction in most people.
causes: Immune system overreaction to allergens.
symptoms: Itching of the nose, eyes or roof of the mouth
prevention: Avoid known triggers, keep a diary to identify allergens.
treatment_action: Antihistamines, nasal sprays, or immunotherapy (allergy shots).
complications: Anaphylaxis (life-threatening), asthma, sinusitis, and ear/lung infections.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A progressive nervous system disease that affects nerve cells in the brain and spinal cord, causing loss of muscle control.
causes: Unknown in most cases, but 5-10% of cases are inherited.
symptoms: Weakness in legs, feet or ankles
prevention: No known way to prevent ALS.
treatment_action: Medications to slow progression, physical therapy, and speech therapy.
complications: Breathing problems, speaking problems, eating problems, and dementia.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A bulge in a blood vessel caused by a weakness in the blood vessel wall, usually where it branches.
causes: High blood pressure, atherosclerosis, trauma, or heredity.
symptoms: Often no symptoms until it ruptures
Pain in the chest or abdomen (if aortic aneurysm)
prevention: Manage blood pressure, quit smoking, and eat a healthy diet.
treatment_action: Monitoring, medications, or surgery to repair the vessel.
complications: Rupture leading to internal bleeding, stroke, or death.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart.
causes: Coronary artery disease (narrowing of heart arteries).
symptoms: Pain in arms, neck, jaw, shoulder or back
prevention: Quit smoking, monitor and control high blood pressure/cholesterol, exercise regularly.
treatment_action: Lifestyle changes, medications (nitrates), or medical procedures (stenting, bypass).
complications: Heart attack.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An eating disorder characterized by an abnormally low body weight, an intense fear of gaining weight and a distorted perception of weight.
causes: Biological, psychological, and environmental factors.
prevention: Early intervention and promoting healthy body image.
treatment_action: Medical care, nutritional counseling, and psychotherapy.
complications: Anemia, heart problems, bone loss, kidney problems, and death.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: Mental health disorders characterized by feelings of worry, anxiety, or fear that are strong enough to interfere with one's daily activities.
causes: Genetics, brain chemistry, and life events.
symptoms: Having a sense of impending danger
prevention: Get help early, stay active, and avoid alcohol/drug use.
treatment_action: Psychotherapy (CBT) and medications (antidepressants, anti-anxiety drugs).
complications: Depression, substance misuse, trouble sleeping, and digestive problems.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A condition related to brain development that impacts how a person perceives and socializes with others, causing problems in social interaction and communication.
causes: Genetics and environmental factors.
symptoms: Lack of response to their name
prevention: No known way to prevent autism.
treatment_action: Behavior and communication therapies, educational therapies, and family therapies.
complications: Problems in school or with successful employment, inability to live independently, and social isolation.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An autoimmune disorder that causes your hair to come out, often in clumps the size and shape of a quarter.
causes: The immune system attacks hair follicles.
prevention: No known way to prevent alopecia areata.
treatment_action: Corticosteroids, immunotherapy, or topical medications.
complications: Emotional distress and low self-esteem.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An infection of the intestines caused by the parasite Entamoeba histolytica.
causes: Ingesting contaminated food or water.
symptoms: Rectal pain while having a bowel movement
prevention: Wash hands, drink safe water, and eat cooked food.
treatment_action: Antibiotics and antiparasitic medications.
complications: Liver abscess, spread to other organs.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A serious infectious disease caused by gram-positive, rod-shaped bacteria known as Bacillus anthracis.
causes: Contact with anthrax spores, usually through infected animals or animal products.
prevention: Vaccination (for high-risk individuals) and avoiding infected animals.
treatment_action: Antibiotics and antitoxins.
complications: Meningitis, septicemia, and death.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A common and generally treatable imperfection in the curvature of the eye that causes blurred distance and near vision.
causes: Irregularly shaped cornea or lens.
prevention: No known way to prevent astigmatism.
treatment_action: Eyeglasses, contact lenses, or refractive surgery (LASIK).
complications: Amblyopia (lazy eye) if left untreated in children.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: Hardening and narrowing of the arteries, which can restrict blood flow.
causes: High cholesterol, high blood pressure, smoking, and diabetes.
symptoms: Often no symptoms until an artery is severely narrowed or blocked
prevention: Healthy diet, regular exercise, quitting smoking, and managing weight.
treatment_action: Lifestyle changes, medications (statins), or surgical procedures.
complications: Heart attack, stroke, peripheral artery disease, and aneurysm.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A chronic condition including attention difficulty, hyperactivity, and impulsiveness.
causes: Genetics, environment, and problems with the central nervous system during development.
prevention: No known way to prevent ADHD.
treatment_action: Behavioral therapy, medications (stimulants), and educational support.
complications: Poor school or work performance, accidents and injuries, and poor self-esteem.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A rare disorder that makes it difficult for food and liquid to pass into your stomach.
causes: Damage to the nerves in the esophagus.
prevention: No known way to prevent achalasia.
treatment_action: Pneumatic dilation, surgery (Heller myotomy), or Botox injections.
complications: Esophagitis, aspiration pneumonia, and increased risk of esophageal cancer.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A digestive disorder that occurs when stomach acid or bile flows back into the food pipe (esophagus).
causes: Weakness in the lower esophageal sphincter.
symptoms: Regurgitation of food or sour liquid
Sensation of a lump in your throat
prevention: Maintain a healthy weight, avoid trigger foods, and don't lie down after a meal.
treatment_action: Antacids, H2 blockers, proton pump inhibitors, or surgery.
complications: Narrowing of the esophagus (stricture), esophageal ulcer, and Barrett's esophagus.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A disorder in which the adrenal glands don't produce enough hormones.
causes: Autoimmune response, infections, or tumors affecting the adrenal glands.
prevention: No known way to prevent Addison's disease.
treatment_action: Hormone replacement therapy to correct the levels of steroid hormones.
complications: Addisonian crisis (life-threatening low blood pressure).
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A type of anxiety disorder in which you fear and avoid places or situations that might cause you to panic and make you feel trapped, helpless or embarrassed.
causes: Biology, including health conditions and genetics, temperament, environmental stress and learning experiences.
symptoms: Fear of crowds or waiting in line
prevention: Get help early for anxiety or panic attacks.
treatment_action: Psychotherapy (CBT) and medications (antidepressants).
complications: Depression, alcohol or drug abuse, and other mental health disorders.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A group of inherited disorders that results in little or no production of the pigment melanin.
causes: Mutation in one of several genes that provide instructions for producing or distributing melanin.
symptoms: Very light skin, hair, and eyes
prevention: Albinism is a genetic disorder, so it cannot be prevented. Genetic counseling is recommended for those with a family history.
treatment_action: Sun protection and regular eye exams.
complications: Skin cancer and social/emotional challenges.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A chronic relapsing brain disease characterized by an impaired ability to stop or control alcohol use despite adverse social, occupational, or health consequences.
causes: Genetic, psychological, social and environmental factors.
symptoms: Inability to limit the amount of alcohol you drink
Strong need or urge to drink alcohol
Withdrawal symptoms when you don't drink
prevention: Early intervention and education about the risks of alcohol misuse.
treatment_action: Detoxification, counseling, and medications.
complications: Liver disease, heart problems, increased risk of cancer, and weakened immune system.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: Refers to the loss of memories, such as facts, information and experiences.
causes: Damage to areas of the brain that are vital for memory processing.
symptoms: Difficulty remembering past events and previously familiar information
prevention: Avoid brain injury, treat strokes quickly, and avoid excessive alcohol use.
treatment_action: Occupational therapy and technological assistance.
complications: Difficulty with daily activities and social interaction.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A rare disease that occurs when a substance called amyloid builds up in your organs.
causes: Abnormal protein production.
symptoms: Numbness, tingling or pain in hands or feet
prevention: No known way to prevent amyloidosis.
treatment_action: Chemotherapy, heart medications, or organ transplant.
complications: Kidney failure, heart failure, and nervous system damage.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: An inflammatory disease that, over time, can cause some of the small bones in your spine (vertebrae) to fuse.
causes: The exact cause is unknown, though genetic factors seem to be involved.
symptoms: Pain and stiffness in your lower back and hips
prevention: No known way to prevent ankylosing spondylitis.
treatment_action: Physical therapy and medications (NSAIDs, biologics).
complications: Eye inflammation (uveitis), compression fractures, and heart problems.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: The partial or complete loss of the sense of smell.
causes: Nasal congestion, nasal polyps, or damage to the olfactory nerve.
symptoms: Change in the way things smell
prevention: Avoid head injuries and treat nasal infections promptly.
treatment_action: Treating the underlying cause (e.g., decongestants, surgery for polyps).
complications: Loss of interest in eating and inability to detect dangerous odors (smoke, gas).
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.
